snippet.description:
A lasting side effect of the COVID-19 pandemic: we've forgotten our manners. Gen Z didn't learn how to act in the workplace — and everyone else seemed to unlearn it too. 

On this week’s episode of Explain It to Me, host Jonquilyn Hill talks to NYU associate professor Tessa West about why you might have forgotten office etiquette, and why it still matters.
